title: Claude artifacts now install as desktop apps, with permissions tied to each version
summary: Anthropic opened a beta that turns Claude artifacts into desktop applications on macOS and Windows. A user describes a tool in chat, chooses Install as app, and gets an icon, its own window, notifications and an optional menu-bar or system-tray presence. Installation adds a desktop container rather than a copy, so later edits to the artifact change the installed app, and opening it requires a signed-in session and a connection. Anthropic says it does not review apps before installation, and that a permission grant covers only the version that was approved, not the next update.
